verdict.rationale: LibreOffice is software you run yourself. Its docs show a headless mode for control by external clients via the API, a UNO acceptor for server-style operation, and a `--convert-to` batch conversion CLI. A community user also reports running it in Docker to generate PDFs and normalize formats. missing for 10: an official first-party container image or server-deployment guide, and documentation of embedding the engine as a library beyond the SDK/extension mention.

support.subject: As a developer, the conversion engine runs inside my own infrastructure as a library, container, or server I operate

citations.quote: Starts in "headless mode" which allows using the application without user interface. This special mode can be used when the application is controlled by external clients via the API.
Notifies LibreOffice software that upon the creation of "UNO Acceptor Threads", a "UNO Accept String" will be used.
Also runs it in Docker to generate PDFs from templates and normalize document formats.
